description:
Play Human Fall Flat - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/human-fall-flat-nintendo-switch-2-edition-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1021-01&utm_id=P1021-01 

Human Fall Flat is a light-hearted physics platformer set in floating landscapes, now with new Nintendo Switch 2 features like mouse controls, GameChat, and GameShare. Wiggle and wobble your way through fantastical environments, from brand new levels like Candyland to classics like Aztec adventures. Play either solo or with up to 8 players online. And, you can customize your Human to your heart's content!
